pages.title: Mirror Culture Vat
pages.text: A sealed vat fed only mirror-handed nutrient, growing cells built the wrong way round.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the chirality purity and the mirror-nutrient feed. A mirror cell grows only on nearly pure mirror food; purity must reach 99%. Any natural nutrient (purity under 90%) poisons it.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Chiral Ligand, Mirror Antibody, Mirror Cell.
